Start Tic-Tac-Toe

      

        
        
        
        
        

          
          
          
          

            
            
            
            
          

          
          
          
Both players race on the same private server word. First solver wins; timeout compares progress.

        

        

          
          
          
          
          
Invite up to seven available people. The server rotates the drawer and chooses each word.

        

        

          
          
          
          
          
Start alone or invite up to seven available players. Answers are written on the canvas and recognized locally in the browser.

        

        

          

            
            
            
            
            
            

          

          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          

            

            
            
            
            Built-in quiz artwork
          

          
Questions

          

          
Each question needs 2–6 answers and one correct answer. Low, average and high questions use progressively larger base scores. Players can answer Play safe (1×) or Confident (2× when correct; a wrong Confident answer deducts points).

        

        

          
          
          
          
          
          
          
Mandatory captures are enforced. White outlines show movable pieces; green destinations are normal moves and red destinations are captures.

        

        

          
          
          
Complete chess rules are enforced: check, checkmate, stalemate, castling, en passant, promotion, repetition, the fifty-move rule, and insufficient material.
